notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
- Tiger re-added as playable character and AI bot (further optimized)
- Lion and Lionesses now given unique SFX to differentiate from the Tiger
- Lions do slightly less damage than Tigers now

notes.title: AI Crocodile Bug Fix
notes.notes: - A bug in the new update which makes Crocodile AI invulnerable has been patched.

notes.title: minor changes
notes.notes: - minor

notes.title: Re-vert to latest version, clean up
notes.notes: see above*

notes.title: Title update
notes.notes:
AI Hunters:
- Fixed Issue with AI Hunters finding a target.
- AI Hunters can now get IMPALED by Deer and Elephant Horns

- Re-added Regeneration to Animals and Hunters. With faster regen time for Hunters.
- More ammo boxes.

notes.title: AI Spawn Bug Fix
notes.notes: - New update involved a bug in which the AI would spawn in the exact same position and would get stuck inside eachother. Fixed now.

notes.title: Some changes
notes.notes:
- Fox attack values altered
- Attack reactions now have a 25% chance in Multiplayer to minimize spam locking from Foxes/Wolves
- HUD Weapon change

notes.title: Patch
notes.notes:
- Fixed issue with 'Force All Weapons' setting where the appropriate Weapon would not be set.
- Added Grey and Arctic Fox to Forced Animal Selection
- Added a 'Knife' to Forced Hunter Weapon
- Fixed issue with 'Pine' not loading Bots

notes.title: gameplay changes
notes.notes:
* health Regeneration removed
* Pistol, Shotgun, and Base Assault Rifle now stronger
* Fox Hitbox altered - meaning Hunter Bots now miss more shots

notes.title: HUD Update, Nighttime Canyon Adjustment
notes.notes:
- Added a 'press button for flashlight' message when toggled with 'h' key
- canyon nighttime adjustments

notes.title: patch
notes.notes: - fix for AI Bug since latest update, where Animal Bots will 'walk' towards enemies during combat.

notes.title: Bot Changes
notes.notes:
- Increased Speed for Deer Bot! *sniff sniff*., & decreased Damage
- Increased Trot and Sprint speed for Bears
- removed Wolf Bot

notes.title: minor changes
notes.notes:
- removed fall damage for elephant
- Grizzly Bot has decreased speed

[u]Fixes:[/u]

- Ammo widgets now visible on Rockies Map

notes.title: Animal Changes
notes.notes:
- Tiger has received an attack buff, now costs more money in the Animal Selector
- Replaced the playable Brown Bear with the Black Bear.

notes.title: Weapon Store Patch
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor will not disappear after you have exited the store, causing sever gameplay issues.
- Fixed an issue where the widget inputs affect gameplay inputs

:) .

notes.title: Balancing & Patching Update
notes.notes:
- Removed troublesome rocks on 'Rockies' map
- Fixed all stairs on Winter Town map
- Buffed Fox attack range, more health for Fox (Is now 3 pistol bullets to take down the fox instead of 1
- Deer has more health (450 Health)
- Bot Shotgun fire rate slowed down!
- Grizzly Bear has more health (2400 Health)

notes.title: Minor Changes
notes.notes:
- Kill SFX
- Increased Price for Shotgun ($600 to $800) & Assault Rifle ($900 to $1400)
- Changed Water Texture on Canyon
- Reduced Capsule Attack Range on both Fox and Wolf

notes.title: Animal Widget Update
notes.notes: Added buttons for animal ability to the 'Animal Controls' tab.

notes.title: Bug Fixes, Scorpion Logic
notes.notes:
Money Logic Fixes:

- Fixed Bug where playing as an Animals on SP, your currency never gets spent upon purchasing a new animal.

- Penalty for being killed is removed for SP as well as Online

Scorpion is now undetectable by SP Hunter Bots when underground.

notes.title: Money Logic Changes
notes.notes:
- Cash price allocation of $1000 at match start
- Buy Stations moved closer to human spawns
- Shotgun is now $600, Rifle at $900

notes.title: Title Update
notes.notes:
New Game Features:
- ADDED Scorpion to animal roster, (WIP)
- Added Purchase Function to Team Deathmatch (You must now pay for Animals and Guns in-session, money is earned from Kills) Happy Hunting!
- Buy Station added to Maps

Bug fixing:
- Removed buggy 'Death Camera'
- Fixed camera rotation for animals

Extras:
- Fox deals less damage, range shortened.
